name: access-lines-verification
description: Check all 6 Grove access lines are operational before critical operations
steps: ProtonDrive: 'rclone about protondrive:' should show storage
Syncthing: Check http://127.0.0.1:8384 for connected devices
Tailscale: 'tailscale status' should show all nodes
Grove Drive: 'ls /mnt/grove' should list vault contents
